Description: Manual CodeBuild for public Nuxt UI. Builds exact public GitHub branch and publishes static output to private S3.

Source.BuildSpec: {"version":0.2,"phases":{"install":{"runtime-versions":{"nodejs":22},"commands":["git clone --single-branch --branch fix/cognito-callback-hydration https://github.com/examplessdk-lgtm/1origin.git \"$CODEBUILD_SRC_DIR/origin-src\"","git -C \"$CODEBUILD_SRC_DIR/origin-src\" checkout --detach 16bbf41683bbc2f6313a6ee75aee7fc342662560","test \"$(git -C \"$CODEBUILD_SRC_DIR/origin-src\" rev-parse HEAD)\" = \"16bbf41683bbc2f6313a6ee75aee7fc342662560\"","cd \"$CODEBUILD_SRC_DIR/origin-src/ui/nuxt\" && npm ci --no-audit --no-fund"]},"build":{"commands":["cd \"$CODEBUILD_SRC_DIR/origin-src\" && node --experimental-strip-types --test backend/*.test.cjs ui/nuxt/test/*.test.mjs","cd \"$CODEBUILD_SRC_DIR/origin-src/ui/nuxt\" && npm run typecheck","cd \"$CODEBUILD_SRC_DIR/origin-src/ui/nuxt\" && npm run generate","test -f \"$CODEBUILD_SRC_DIR/origin-src/ui/nuxt/.output/public/import/index.html\"","test -f \"$CODEBUILD_SRC_DIR/origin-src/ui/nuxt/.output/public/auth/callback/index.html\"","grep -Rl 'Use connected GitHub App' \"$CODEBUILD_SRC_DIR/origin-src/ui/nuxt/.output/public\" --include=\"*.html\" >/dev/null","test -s \"$CODEBUILD_SRC_DIR/origin-src/ui/nuxt/.output/public/preview/index.html\""]},"post_build":{"commands":["test \"$CODEBUILD_BUILD_SUCCEEDING\" = \"1\"","test -f \"$CODEBUILD_SRC_DIR/origin-src/ui/nuxt/.output/public/import/index.html\"","aws s3 sync \"s3://$FRONTEND_BUCKET\" \"s3://$FRONTEND_BUCKET/_origin_releases/build-$CODEBUILD_BUILD_NUMBER/\" --exclude \"_origin_releases/*\" --only-show-errors","aws s3 sync \"$CODEBUILD_SRC_DIR/origin-src/ui/nuxt/.output/public\" \"s3://$FRONTEND_BUCKET\" --exclude \"*.html\" --only-show-errors","aws s3 cp \"$CODEBUILD_SRC_DIR/origin-src/ui/nuxt/.output/public/\" \"s3://$FRONTEND_BUCKET/\" --recursive --exclude \"*\" --include \"*.html\" --cache-control \"no-cache\" --only-show-errors","aws cloudfront create-invalidation --distribution-id \"$DISTRIBUTION_ID\" --paths \"/*\""]}}}
